plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish powers while Matriarch sleeps. Have reliable poison, improved blocking, weakness, and healthy entry HP; poison remains effective after strength drains.
plan.summary: Add immediate damage first, then reliable poison and defensive scaling. Remove Strikes once damage replacements exist. Fight elites with adequate health and potions; balance healing with core upgrades.

plan.archetype: Efficient poison scaling with weakness and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish defensive powers during sleep. Apply reliable poison, maintain weakness, and enter healthy. Upgrade poison, Footwork, or Neutralize when health permits.
plan.summary: Heal now and retain one elite followed by a campfire. Add efficient poison and defensive scaling rather than redundant attacks. Remove Strikes after replacements; upgrade core cards when healthy.
